result.answer: Spotify's return/refund/cancellation policy (from the Paid Subscription Terms and Conditions): Users may cancel their Paid Subscription at any time through their account page. Cancellation takes effect from the end of the billing period in which you cancel (i.e., you retain access until the current paid billing period ends). Regarding refunds: Spotify generally does not provide refunds for unused portions of a billing cycle. Specifically, there are 'no refunds available for changing from your then-current Paid Subscription before the end of your then-current Paid Subscription period,' and any unused time already paid for will be forfeited. Exceptions exist if Spotify permanently discontinues a subscription (in which case a prorated refund of prepaid fees is issued) or if the subscription was purchased through a third party (in which case the third party handles refunds). For trial periods, users must cancel before the trial ends to avoid being charged. Time window: No fixed time window — cancellation can be done at any time, with effects taking place at the end of the current billing period. No explicit refund window is offered beyond this.
